app.title: Continente MCP
app.disclaimer: Continente MCP server for AI agents (Cesto and others). Independent project, not affiliated with Continente. Each agent uses its own token.
status.title: Status
status.checkout_on: Warning: the allow_checkout option is on. Checkout or payment tools, if any exist, are available to every token.
account.title: Continente account
account.remove_confirm: Remove the saved email and password?
login.title: Sign in
login.help: Opens a browser on this page to sign in to Continente and answer "I'm not a robot". The session is kept by the add-on.
tokens.title: Agent tokens
tokens.help: One token per agent. Every token can read and change the cart. Each change is written to the add-on log with the agent name.
tokens.name: Agent name
tokens.copy_now: Copy this token now. It is not shown again and is not stored anywhere.
tokens.copy_failed: Could not copy: select and copy it by hand.
tokens.revoke_confirm: Revoke the token of "{name}"? The agent loses access.
requests.title: Token requests
requests.help: Another add-on asked for a token. Approve only if you recognise the name and the fingerprint matches the one shown in that add-on.
error.invalid_name: Invalid name: 1 to 40 letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores.
error.name_taken: A token with that name already exists.
error.credentials_missing: Set up the Continente account first.
